name: Paneer tikka masala
steps: Cube the paneer and sear in oil until lightly golden, then set aside.
Soften the onion, then stir in the garam masala and garlic.
Pour in the tinned tomatoes and simmer until thickened.
Stir through the greek yogurt and return the paneer to the sauce.
Simmer for five minutes and serve with the cooked rice.
